name: Chicago Park District summer jobs (lifeguard, recreation leader, junior laborer)
what_you_do: Teens 16 and up can work in the parks. Jobs include lifeguard and day camp recreation leader. You can also be a special recreation leader. Those camps serve kids and adults with intellectual disabilities. Junior laborers do landscape work.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 and older for lifeguards, recreation leaders, special recreation leaders and junior laborers. Lifeguards must be 16 by July 1, 2027. Lifeguards and recreation leaders must live in Chicago when hired.
pay_detail: 2027 lifeguard rate: $21.25 per hour. 2027 rates for the other jobs are not posted. In 2026 they paid $17.77 per hour.
duration: Recreation leaders about 6 weeks, mid-June to early Aug. Junior laborers start April, May or June.
deadline_text: Lifeguard: the 2027 summer application is open now, no deadline listed. Skills tests are Nov 13, 2026 and Dec 19, 2026. The other three jobs open for applications in early 2027. Teen Opportunity Fairs ran Feb 21 to Mar 14 in 2026; 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Lifeguards: apply online with the link on the Be a Lifeguard page. Sign up for a skills test and pass it. Take the Red Cross class, then finish paperwork and fingerprinting. Other jobs: check the Summer Jobs page in early 2027.
notes: Work permit: Illinois requires employment certificates only for minors under 16 (Illinois Dept. of Labor FAQ). All of these jobs start at 16. Teens 13 to 15 should see the Recreation Leader in Training program. Fair email: teensinthepark@chicagoparkdistrict.com.
